about_the_game:
Monster Mage Madness Unleash Your Inner Mage in a Chaotic, Magical Adventure!

Dive into Monster Mage Madness, a thrilling roguelike where you wield powerful magic to battle hordes of monstrous foes in a vibrant, procedurally generated world. Choose your mage, customize your abilities, and team up with magical pets to conquer ever-changing challenges. With persistent upgrades and dynamic combat, every run is a fresh spell-slinging spectacle!

Key Features:

  • Dynamic Combat: Blast enemies with homing bullets, multi-shots, and critical hits. Upgrade your mage with boosts like lifesteal, shields, and enhanced attack speed for endless build variety.

  • Procedural World: Explore a tile-based map across unique biomes, each with distinct enemies and surprises, ensuring no two runs are alike.

  • Persistent Progression: Earn Level Experience to unlock permanent upgrades, from increased health to bullet speed, enhancing your power across playthroughs.

  • Magical Pets: Find the kennels to recruit loyal companions to aid in combat, adding strategic depth to your magical arsenal.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Pentium 4 1.6 GHz or equivalent (any dual-core CPU from the last 10-15 years)
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Any DirectX 9.0c-compatible GPU (e.g., NVIDIA GeForce 6100 or Intel HD Graphics)

short_description: Top down 2D bullet hell survivor. Use your level reached to purchase permanent upgrades to help you get further in the next run!
